rubric: Should detect Node 20 from .nvmrc and engines.node, install nodejs_20 (not generic nodejs), set NODE_ENV var, and include an on-activate hook that runs npm install when package-lock.json changes. Penalize using generic 'nodejs' instead of 'nodejs_20', missing hook, or absolute paths.

Should detect Python 3.12 from pyproject.toml requires-python, install python3 and uv, use $FLOX_ENV_CACHE/venv (never ./venv or ./.venv), and use 'uv sync' (not 'uv pip install -r') because uv.lock is present. Must include profile section to activate venv in interactive shells. Penalize wrong venv path, missing uv, using pip instead of uv.

Should detect Go from go.mod (go 1.21), install the go package (plain 'go' or versioned 'go_1_21' are both acceptable), set GOPATH/GOCACHE/GOMODCACHE to $FLOX_ENV_CACHE paths in the hook, and add GOPATH/bin to PATH in profile. Penalize missing GOPATH setup, absolute paths in hook.

Should install cargo and rustc (and ideally clippy/rustfmt) in a rust-toolchain pkg-group, set CARGO_HOME and CARGO_TARGET_DIR to $FLOX_ENV_CACHE paths, add CARGO_HOME/bin to PATH. Platform-specific linkers (gcc on Linux, clang on macOS) are a bonus. Penalize missing CARGO_HOME setup, absolute paths.

Should install ruby (plain 'ruby' or versioned 'ruby_3_3' from Gemfile.lock are both acceptable), detect Gemfile+Gemfile.lock and add bundle install hook using BUNDLE_PATH in $FLOX_ENV_CACHE. Should detect Ruby 3.3.0 from Gemfile.lock. Penalize missing bundle install hook, placing vendor/ at absolute path, or skipping Gemfile detection.

Should install nodejs_20 (from engines.node) plus postgresql (detected from pg dependency and DATABASE_URL in .env.example). PostgreSQL should be wired as a Flox [services.postgres] section (no docker-compose.yml present). Should set PGHOST/PGPORT/PGUSER/PGDATABASE vars and include initdb in hook. Penalize missing [services] section, missing PGDATA setup, wrong nodejs version.
